Definition: Brain mass estimated from endocranial (skull-cavity) volume, expressed in grams. The reported estimate is retained; this is not a weighing or a tissue-volume measurement. Skull capacity may have been measured with beads, seeds, shot, or imaging.

Code: Brain mass (measured or estimated from volume)
Definition: Best-available species brain mass in grams, selected from the separate traits: directly measured mass first; otherwise mass estimated from brain-tissue volume, then endocranial volume, then volume of unresolved subtype. The selected value and source counts are copied unchanged; methods are not averaged together. Measurement method, selected trait and selection reason are retained. Excludes unresolved-method records, explicitly olfactory-bulb-excluded masses and sums of brain structures.
Note: Selection view, not an additional measurement or a cross-method average. Selected source-level means remain in their separate traits.
